title: How to automate your entire business with no-code AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know you can automate your whole business in under 30 minutes?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: No-code AI is changing how startups and small businesses operate today.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s AI tools that let you build smart workflows without writing a single line of code.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Tools like Zapier and Bubble now integrate with AI to automate tasks like customer service and data analysis.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects 80% of small businesses that spend 15+ hours a week on repetitive tasks.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key takeaway? You don’t need a developer to scale your business anymore.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to automate your business? Let me know in the comments.
